verdict.rationale: The bring-your-own half is well documented: Open WebUI connects to Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenRouter, vLLM, Groq, etc.) via a custom Base URL, and it can use existing Codex/Claude Code/Cursor subscriptions as chat backends. Nothing in the pack shows token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation, which is half the story. Missing for 10: token usage visibility, per-model or per-conversation cost reporting, independent corroboration.
